programmes.d: A Navy officer is murdered the same way his parents were murdered a decade ago; the team stumbles across a storage container filled with dollhouses that display re-creations of murder scenes; the team members agree to clean out their living spaces.
The body of a well-regarded Navy technician is found floating in a lake, which isn't far from where a popular community event takes place; Sloane's daughter makes an unexpected request.
When Kasie and Jimmy are held hostage in a diner after a jewelry store robbery goes awry, they attempt to keep the other customers safe from the thieves.
The team tries to verify the identity of Joe Smith, who claims he served on the U.S.S. Arizona during the attack on Pearl Harbor and wants to be buried there upon his death.
Gibbs and Fornell attempt to track down the leader of a drug ring who supplied drugs to Fornell's daughter; the team deals with the case of a missing cadaver from the NCIS autopsy room.
Flashbacks reveal the murder case that first introduced young Gibbs to NCIS and to Ducky.
The discovery of two dead bodies in a forest leads the NCIS team into the wild world of modern-day treasure hunting; Gibbs and Fornell get deeper into their search for the opioid kingpin.
McGee and his wife Delilah's Bahamian vacation turns into a high-stakes mission; Gibbs fears the worst when his search for Fornell leads to blood.

Following a tip about smuggled weapons, Bishop and Torres engage in a shootout in a former sheriff's residence that's now a historical site, only to find themselves locked in abandoned jail cells there.
NCIS investigates the murder of a Navy officer who was killed while driving home a recently released inmate; Gibbs helps Palmer deal with a personal trauma.

When Sloane's name is discovered in Afghanistan at the site of an abandoned bus with a dead driver, Gibbs accompanies her on a trip to find a group of girls who were kidnapped from the bus; a hacker emails compromising information to the Taliban.
Reeling from his father's murder, Parker goes to extreme lengths to hunt down the woman he holds responsible, mob boss Carla Marino, jeopardizing not only his own future but the team's.
Parker's pursuit of vengeance for his father's murder could have deadly consequences; Parker's sister faces an impossible choice.
When a petty officer's death is connected to a blackmail investigation, the team is forced to work with Special Agent Sawyer on the case, which takes a terrifying turn for Torres.
The team investigates a U.S. marine who is believed to have kidnapped the wife of one of the most powerful men at the Department of Justice.
NCIS dives into the competitive world of food trucks after finding a man frozen to death in the back of one.
The team uncovers a secret dogfighting ring, which leads to an unexpected move by one of the team members.

Gibbs and Fornell's crusade to find the head of the drug ring responsible for Fornell's daughter Emily's overdose comes to a climax; Gibbs and Vance finally let the team in on a case that has dangerous implications.
Vance assigns McGee, Torres and Bishop to COVID compliance duty at a foreign affairs summit, where they discover a link to another NCIS team's murder case.
A performer's life is threatened, so Toby poses as her assistant and helps to investigate.
An African teenager, whose father is an alleged war criminal, is abducted.
Toby's telepathy acts as surveillance when Michelle goes undercover to expose an art-theft ring.
Evidence from the stabbing of a Marine sergeant leads Torres to meet his father, who left when Torres was a child.
The team investigates a biker killed in a hit-and-run; Gibbs prepares to testify against a financial adviser who stole millions from his Navy clients.
NCIS tracks a stolen laptop to the uncle of a young boy, Phineas, Gibbs' former neighbor.
